headline: President Bush set new pay rates for certain federal government jobs, likely the yearly federal pay adjustment for 2006.
what_it_does: The order adjusts rates of pay for certain federal positions. Orders with this title are usually issued each December to set the next year's pay schedules for federal workers. No summary was provided, so the exact jobs and amounts are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Their pay rates may change under the new pay schedules set by the order.
Annual pay orders like this one often cover military pay rates, though the source material here does not confirm it.
